_README: Phase 2 parse-ceiling probes. For each answerable eval question, the minimum evidence that must survive parsing for the answer to be findable at all. If a probe fails, no retriever in later phases can ever get that question right. 'text' = substrings searched in the parsed output of that file (any one alternative counts). 'cell' = sheet/cell address that must hold that value. 'manual' = needs the owner's eye, no string test is honest.
